Phase 37 implemented on branch phase-37-cockpit-launchpad (findings: docs/phases/cockpit-launchpad-lead-conversation-findings.md; every in-cycle gate recorded there). Suite 969 passed / 5 skipped. Version 3.1.0.

Delivered against the approved plan (round 5):
- A. `tagteam serve` bare = cockpit (loopback); `--theme saloon` byte-identical to the pre-3.1 bare page (identity test retargeted); banner "Tagteam cockpit — <project> — <phase · type · rN · state | no active cycle> → URL". Port exclusion = real bind + project-independent port lease (`~/.tagteam/ports/<port>.json`, pid+identity, O_EXCL, released on shutdown incl. SIGTERM, stale=dead pid or definitive identity mismatch, unverifiable=held) + pre-bind connect probe for the loopback/wildcard shadow; holder named only from a verified lease or `/api/info` app:tagteam (added to cockpit/saloon/hub); observed live against the arbiter's stray 3.0.0 servers on 8080.
- Turn slot: `headless.claim_turn_slot/update_turn_slot/release_turn_slot/slot_status` under dualwrite.writer_lock (claim only), owner_token, existing marker keys retained + kind/conversation fields, owner-only unlink, definitive-only recovery (fail closed on unverifiable/legacy); wired into HeadlessEngine._run_attempt (Busy → tick declined, engine.slot_busy), the briefer (Busy → refused), and the watcher's headless tick which re-dispatches the still-owed turn once the slot frees (mock-safe); watcher_status is kind-aware.
- B. `launch.launch_intent` (the plan's matrix; `roadmap.is_terminal_status` normalizes Complete/✅/Absorbed/Deferred/Superseded and `get_incomplete_phases` uses it — regression on a copy of this repo's roadmap), `start_payload` gated on HeadlessEngine.validate(), composite `launch` with a persisted `launches` claim (UNIQUE key = sha256(command+observed), owner pid/ident, attempt, per-step refs, partial JSON) claimed under a short lock, side effects outside (start_watcher: detached --pidfile, ≤5 s pidfile-or-early-exit; the lead's first conversation turn), repeat → existing, concurrent → one insert, orphaned pending reconciled on start/request, retry:true = atomic failed→pending attempt+1 rerunning only missing steps (alive watcher reused, existing turn returned, persisted conversation reused); stop_watcher (identity-checked pidfile only), start_session (manual returns commands). Endpoints: GET /api/start; POST /api/start/launch (the legacy Saloon keeps /api/launch), /api/watch/start|stop, /api/session/start; Start card, watcher chip Start/Stop, approved-state intent, empty-state reason.
- C. `lead_chat`: conversations under .tagteam/conversations/<c-12hex>/ (transcript.md, <n>.log, <n>.events.jsonl), DB v7 (conversations, conversation_turns incl. reply/continuity, launches, usage.kind; NON_FILE_BACKED_TABLES parent-before-child); `send` = one adapter turn with the lead's headless spec (claude --session-id/--resume; codex `build_conversation_argv` → exec --json -C root <policy> --skip-git-repo-check resume <id> - when `codex_resume_supported()` probes true, else budgeted transcript replay; runtime resume failure → failed turn, never replayed), slot kind=conversation, usage kind=conversation, running→ok|failed|cancelled, no pause marker on failure, `reconcile` orphaned running rows on server start and `tagteam lead --list`, `cancel` via bind_inflight, `turn_events` with ids <n>:<seq>/<n>:end replayable from a cursor. Server: GET /api/lead, /api/lead/<cid>, /api/lead/<cid>/events (Last-Event-ID / ?after= replay then live), POST /api/lead/new, /send (202; 409 busy with reason while a cycle turn holds the slot; 413 >32 KB; 400 empty; dry-run), /cancel; ids regex+DB-validated before any path join, path containment asserted. UI: Lead tab first, DOM via createElement/textContent only (JS-source guard + browser check with hostile markup: rendered as text, title unchanged, zero injected elements), composer states idle/sending/busy(+interject)/error, per-conversation SSE with cursor. CLI twin `tagteam lead "msg" [--new] [--conversation ID] [--json] / --list` (exit 3 busy).
- D. Hub rows carry the same intent (read-only, prefetched inputs, no DB); `Start →` (plan/implementation) only when intent.command exists → /p/<id>/#start; hub adds no POSTs.
- E. README ("Talk to the lead, launch, watch and steer"; ladder ③ label + SVG updated together; new cockpit-lead.png), HTW (#cockpit default/lease/launchpad table, new #lead, hub/saloon/files rows), manifest (recipe + 4th screenshot), showcase sentence; pyproject + CITATION 3.1.0.
- F. tests/test_lead_chat.py (18) + tests/test_launchpad.py (17): slot claim/release/owner-only/definitive recovery/fail-closed/barrier race; argv shapes + codex parser smoke + probe cache; chat e2e with resume argv assertions, codex replay/resume, refuse-while-cycle-turn + marker kind, failed turn no pause, orphan reconcile, events replay/cursor, id/size boundaries, not-configured; roadmap terminal normalization on this repo's roadmap; watcher slot re-dispatch; intent matrix incl. exhausted/not-set-up/paused/skip-by-name; headless gate; idempotent launch; concurrent barrier (one watcher, one message); watcher early-exit + partial + retry reuse; three crash windows reconciled+retryable; SSE fast-finish/reconnect/after-end; busy 409 + boundaries + 413 + dry-run; hostile reply round-trip + no-innerHTML guard; watch/session/launch endpoints + legacy /api/launch untouched; port lease both orders/stale/unverifiable/foreign token; serve refusal (unrelated → generic, Tagteam holder named) + immediate restart; hub rows; CLI. conftest isolates the lease dir for every test.

Gates (findings): user walk-through on the seeded idle project (Start card with the exact intent, all three buttons, headless primary because validate() passed; Lead panel with a two-turn conversation; watcher chip Start) captured as docs/media/screenshots/cockpit-lead.png (1280×800, token/paths absent); real `claude -p` conversation on this repo via `tagteam lead` — second message resumed the session (the lead restated the first), transcript + logs on disk, two usage rows kind=conversation, slot free after; hostile markup rendered as text in the browser; port refusal observed live; SIGTERM releases the lease.

Deviations noted for you: composite route is /api/start/launch (legacy Saloon owns /api/launch); conversation_turns gained reply/continuity columns (additive); Playwright hostile check done by hand + JS-source guard in the suite (Playwright is not a test dependency); start_session stubbed in the endpoint test (no terminals in CI); the seed installs the skill contract so Start headless is offered in captures.
